Name: SH's Wild Animals
Author: plurffle
Description:
[font=Arial][b][size=3][size=3]This is the [u]main version[/u] of the Wild Animals mod, which means it does contain content for the main game as well as for Stardew Valley Expanded and provides compatibility for [size=3]Lnh's Ginger Island Overhaul, Piber20's Explorable West Forest[/size]. Please download [b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21231][b]Wild Animals Lite mod[/b][/url]﻿﻿[/b] [/b]if you [u]do not[/u] plan to play with any map-altering mods such as Stardew Valley Expanded.[/size][/size][/b]

[size=2][img]https://imgur.com/KHVvNsv.png[/img][/size]
[size=2]Here is a mod that I was thinking about last year, but I had no idea how to implement it until today. ^_^ I love Stardew Valley's critters, but I was a little sad by how I don't see them often (aside from butterflies and the occasional birds) and how they usually run off to hide in a bush/tree (it is rather realistic though). So, here comes my [b]Wild Animals[/b] mod to fill that animal-shaped void in my heart!

[/size][/font][size=2][font=Arial]This mod adds numerous animals to multiple places in-game, depending on the time, weather, and season. You are pretty much guaranteed to see at least some of the animals as long as you have access to the areas they spawn in. They tend to wander so you may or may not lose sight of some of them, especially if they wander behind the trees or in the grass.

Your first year in-game might not have many wild animals though, maybe the occasional squirrel and the friendly ducks that like to sit in the forest's pond. [i]But [/i]the further you progress in-game, the more animals you may encounter! Maybe some of them would learn not to run away if you get too close to them...

[b]!!! NOTE !!!:[/b] This mod will add extra load for your game to process because of the number of animals and their settings that determine whether they should appear or not on the current in-game day. This mod [i]may[/i] cause lag! However, I personally have not experienced lag during its testing phase with minimal other mods.

[/font][b]Features that I [i]might[/i] add in the future:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2]More aquatic animals?[/size]
[*][size=2]More reptiles/amphibians?[/size]
[*][size=2]Wild animals giving randomized set of items to the player if certain conditions are met (you won't exactly get the most valuable items from [s]most[/s] all of them though!) They might also get their own portraits when you interact with them[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[b]Features that I will not be adding:[/b]
[i]I will [u]not[/u] be using the following ideas even if they are ever implemented to future Custom Companion builds[/i]
[/size][list]

[*][size=2]The ability to kill the wild animals (this will also depend on if there will be a new aggressive behavior added by the framework in the future)[/size]
[/list][font=Arial][size=2]
